description: This file defines an AnalyticsScreen widget for a Flutter application, which displays various analytics related UI components including KPI metrics, charts, score summaries, and task lists. It serves as a frontend UI component with static mock data placeholders, suitable for development of an educational or learning platform.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that constructs the overall analytics page with header, KPIs, charts, score summary, and task list.

classes.name: _KpiRow
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a row of KPI summary cards.

classes.name: _KpiData
classes.description: Data class representing individual KPI metrics such as title, value, icon, and color.

classes.name: _KpiChips
classes.description: A widget that renders a horizontally scrollable list of KPI filter chips.

classes.name: _ChipData
classes.description: Data class for individual KPI filter chip label, icon, and color.

classes.name: _ChartPlaceholder
classes.description: A widget that displays a placeholder for a performance chart with mock data.

classes.name: _ScoreSummary
classes.description: A widget that presents a score summary, including score, sparkline, and segments.

classes.name: _SparklinePainter
classes.description: Custom painter for drawing a small sparkline in the score summary.

classes.name: _TaskList
classes.description: A widget that renders a list of task items related to the user's activities.

classes.name: _TaskItem
classes.description: Data class for individual task items, including title, subtitle, and icon.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the AnalyticsScreen and its components.

methods.name: _KpiRow.build
methods.description: Constructs a row of KPI data cards.

methods.name: _KpiChips.build
methods.description: Builds a horizontally scrollable list of KPI filter chips.

methods.name: _ChartPlaceholder.build
methods.description: Builds the placeholder UI for the performance chart.

methods.name: _ScoreSummary.build
methods.description: Builds the score summary card with sparkline and segments.

methods.name: _SparklinePainter.paint
methods.description: Draws a mock sparkline using Canvas API.

methods.name: _TaskList.build
methods.description: Builds a list of task items with icons and navigation.
